description.value: An herbal or biological ingredient with simple healing properties. Used primarily in healing potions and balms.
Potent restorative ingredient harvested from magical environments or rare beasts. Used in Greater Healing Potions and antidotes.
Ingredient containing condensed magical vitality, harvested from ancient beings or primeval plants.
Legendary regenerative substance capable of restoring organs and lifting dire afflictions.
Mythical drop of phoenix tear or astral lotus; capable of defying death itself.
Common toxin extracted from fungi, serpents, or poisonous plants.
Corrosive or neurotoxic venom harvested from giant scorpions or predatory plants.
Highly lethal poison from creatures such as manticores, hydras, and wyverns.
Supernatural toxin harvested from venomous fiends, ancient green dragons, or horrors.
Supreme venom capable of corrupting soul, matter, and immortal flesh.
Volatile basic substance, sulfur, or mineral salts that catalyze chemical reactions.
Highly unstable compound extracted from fire or frost glands of monsters.
Concentrated energetic catalyst found in pure elemental remnants.
Primordial elemental substance bearing tremendous kinetic and thermal power.
Pure primordial spark of concentrated chaos and heat from astral storms.
Spark of pure formulated or distilled magic. Used in enchantments and scrolls.
Translucent orb of condensed arcane power from CR 5–10 magical creatures.
Dense arcane power pulsing with high-level spectral energy.
Pure arcane power gathered from archmages or cosmic horrors.
Essence capable of bending the weave to sustain permanent artifacts.
Shard of grace and sacred radiance.
Blessed spiritual power from lesser celestials or devoted servants.
Living celestial light or potent unholy remnant from a venerable planar entity.
Raw power of nature, animal spirits, and earthly elements.
Wild life force extracted from apex predators or woodland spirits.
Unshakeable vigor harvested from dragons or titanic forces.
Block of smelted raw iron (2 lbs). Used for tools, nails, and non-combat mundane gear.
Tough iron-carbon alloy (2 lbs). The universal standard for quality weapons and armor.
Refined silver (2 lbs). Used for silvering weapons against lycanthropes or holy jewelry.
Gleaming pure gold (2 lbs). Used in ornamental gear, gilding, and arcane conduits.
Extremely light and resilient silvery metal (1 lb). Crafts silent armors with no Stealth penalty.
One of the hardest known minerals (2 lbs). Turns critical hits into normal hits and destroys objects.
Small leather cutouts useful for straps, sheaths, and field repairs.
Tanned and cured hide from cattle or medium animals. Base for light armors.
Reinforced thick pelt harvested from bears, rhinos, or sturdy beasts.
Tough plates and scales harvested from giant reptiles, monstrosities, or insects.
Gleaming impervious scale from a true dragon. Grants innate elemental protection.
Nails, rudimentary gears, rivets, and iron wire for basic contraptions.
Precision springs, balanced gears, and valves harvested from clockworks or skilled artisans.
Arcane kinetic components salvaged from golems and legendary automata.
Enchanted ink for scribing and creating 1st level arcane scrolls.
Luminous ink for transcribing 2nd and 3rd level scrolls.
Airtight glass bottle (4 oz) for potions, oils, and acids.
